column1: # iPhone and iPad native display resolutions for tools/odyssey.py --preset.
# Screen Diagonal and Release columns), retrieved 2026-10-23. Only iPhone and
# iPad rows are kept, limited to models that run iOS/iPadOS 26, the app's
# deployment target (dm/ios/project.yml). Pixels are portrait, as listed there.
# The preset name is the model lowercased with other characters replaced by -.
# iPhone Duo is omitted: --preset duo (or iphone-duo) builds its live fold layouts.
# iPad rows build the live 4:3 preparation; wider iPhone rows build their own aspect.
